function.name: create_metadata_reader_from_container_iterator
function.description: This function creates a metadata reader from a container iterator. It queries for a metadata reader info interface, checks if the vendor GUID matches the context's vendor, checks if the metadata reader info matches a pattern, seeks to the start of the stream, creates an instance of the metadata reader, queries for a persist stream interface, loads the persist stream, and finally, if successful, sets the context's result to the reader and returns ITER_DONE. If any step fails, it releases any interfaces it has and returns ITER_SKIP.

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: Pointer to an unknown item from which the metadata reader is to be created

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: Pointer to the iterator context that contains the vendor, format, stream, options, and result

function.return_type: enum iterator_result, represents the result of the iteration. It can be ITER_SKIP if the function fails at any step or ITER_DONE if the function successfully creates a metadata reader

function.name: create_metadata_reader_iterator
function.description: This function creates a metadata reader iterator. It checks if the vendor and format of the metadata reader info match the context. If they do, it creates an instance of the metadata reader. If a stream is provided in the context, it seeks to the current position, queries for a persist stream interface, loads the stream, and restores the position. If successful, it sets the context result to the reader and returns ITER_DONE. If any step fails, it skips the item and returns ITER_SKIP.

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: The item to create a metadata reader iterator for.

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: The context containing the vendor and format to match, the stream to load, and the result to set.

function.return_type: enum iterator_result, represents the result of the iterator creation. It returns ITER_DONE if the iterator was successfully created, and ITER_SKIP if the item should be skipped.

function.name: create_metadata_writer_iterator
function.description: This function creates an iterator for a metadata writer. It checks if the vendor and format match the context, and if so, it creates an instance of the metadata writer and assigns it to the context result. If any of these operations fail, it skips the current iteration.

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: Pointer to an unknown item, used to query for a metadata writer info interface.

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: Pointer to the iterator context, which contains the vendor and format to match, and the result to assign the created metadata writer to.

function.return_type: enum iterator_result, represents the result of the iteration. It can be ITER_SKIP if the operation failed or the vendor/format didn't match, or ITER_DONE if the metadata writer was successfully created and assigned.

function.name: foreach_component

parameters.name: context

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the result of the function. It returns S_OK if the context result is not NULL, otherwise it returns WINCODEC_ERR_COMPONENTNOTFOUND.

parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to the metadata reader

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function
